title: IPMC SARS-CoV-2 Two-Step qPCR Protocol on BIOMARK
author: Julien Fassy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd3ii8ke

steps.title: Set up BSL‑2 workspace
steps.instruction: Perform all work in a BSL‑2 laboratory using appropriate biosafety practices.

steps.title: Transfer transport medium
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire transport medium into a 2 mL cryotube.

steps.title: Optional heat inactivation
steps.instruction: If the transport medium is non‑virucidal, heat the sample for 10 min at 65 °C to strongly decrease virus infectivity (note: sensitivity may be reduced).

steps.title: Add carrier RNA (optional)
steps.instruction: Prepare a carrier‑RNA solution containing 5.6 µg carrier RNA per sample (follow the kit handbook table) and add it to Buffer AVL before lysis.

steps.title: Lysis with Buffer AVL
steps.instruction: Transfer 140 µL of the sample into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 560 µL Buffer AVL, close the caps and vortex for >15 s (scale Buffer AVL proportionally if using a different sample volume).

steps.title: Centrifuge to clear lid
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tube to collect any drops that may have adhered to the inside of the lid.

steps.title: Automated RNA extraction (QIAcube)
steps.instruction: Place the tube in the QIAcube and run the viral RNA extraction protocol (default elution volume 60 µL; see the attached QIAcube protocol file).

steps.title: Prepare RT pre‑mix on ice
steps.instruction: In a PCR plate on ice, prepare a reverse‑transcription pre‑mix using Fluidigm Reverse Transcription Master Mix (PN 100‑6297) and RNase‑free water as follows per reaction: 1 µL Master Mix + 2 µL water. For 48 reactions prepare 52.8 µL Master Mix and 105.6 µL water; for 96 reactions 105.6 µL Master Mix and 211.2 µL water; for 192 reactions 211.2 µL Master Mix and 422.4 µL water (includes 10 % overage).

steps.title: Add RNA to RT mix
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of extracted RNA to each well containing the RT pre‑mix, bringing the total volume to 5 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Seal, vortex and spin RT reactions
steps.instruction: Properly seal the plate, gently vortex to mix, then centrifuge at 1000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 min.

steps.title: Reverse transcription thermal cycle
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate in a standard thermal cycler and run the reverse‑transcription program as specified in the protocol (details in the attached thermal‑cycle file).

steps.title: Prepare qPCR pre‑mix (DNA‑free hood)
steps.instruction: In a DNA‑free hood, prepare the sample pre‑mix for the qPCR reactions as shown in the protocol table (includes 10 % overage).

steps.title: Add cDNA to qPCR mix
steps.instruction: In the PCR plate, aliquot 2.25 µL of the qPCR pre‑mix to each well, then add 2.75 µL of cDNA, achieving a total volume of 5 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Mix and spin qPCR reactions
steps.instruction: Briefly vortex the plate to mix, then centrifuge at 1000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 min.

steps.title: qPCR thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the thermal cycler and run the qPCR program as provided in the protocol table.

steps.title: Dilute amplified product 1:5
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Dilution Reagent (Fluidigm PN 100‑8726) to each 5 µL qPCR reaction, yielding a final volume of 25 µL (1 : 5 dilution).

steps.title: Load control line fluid into IFC
steps.instruction: Prepare the control‑line fluid and load it into accumulator 2 (Acc2) of the 192.24 IFC according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Remove IFC protective film
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the blue protective film from the bottom of the IFC.

steps.title: Prepare intermediate primer‑probe solutions
steps.instruction: Mix primers and probe for each target gene in the volumes listed in the handbook to create an intermediate solution for each assay.

steps.title: Pool intermediate solutions into assay mix
steps.instruction: Pool the intermediate solutions into a final pooled TaqMan assay mix (0.2 X) using TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA) so that each primer is at 180 nM and each probe at 50 nM; adjust volumes proportionally to the number of assays (example given for 4 SARS‑CoV‑2 targets).

steps.title: Aliquot 10X assays
steps.instruction: In the DNA‑free hood, aliquot the 10X assay mix into the appropriate wells of the IFC according to the pipetting map (volumes as per the assay table).

steps.title: Prepare sample pre‑mix (TaqMan + loading reagent)
steps.instruction: Combine TaqMan Universal PCR Master Mix with GE Sample Loading Reagent in a 1.5 mL sterile tube; prepare enough volume to fill the entire IFC (2.2 µL of this mix will be used per sample).

steps.title: Combine sample pre‑mix with cDNA
steps.instruction: Remove the aliquoted sample pre‑mix from the hood and add 1.8 µL of cDNA to each 2.2 µL aliquot, giving a total of 4 µL per sample.

steps.title: Load assays and samples onto IFC
steps.instruction: Pipet 3 µL of each 10X assay and 3 µL of the corresponding sample mixture into the designated inlets on the IFC (refer to the 192.24 IFC pipetting map).

steps.title: Prime IFC and run load script
steps.instruction: Prime the IFC on the Controller, place it into the instrument and execute the load script (Juno:Load Mix 192.24 GE – RX:Load Mix 169x). Start the IFC run within 1 hour of loading samples.

steps.title: Add actuation fluid to P1
steps.instruction: Pipet 150 µL of Actuation Fluid into the P1 well of the IFC.

steps.title: Add pressure fluid to P2‑P3
steps.instruction: Pipet 150 µL of Pressure Fluid into each of the P2 and P3 wells.

steps.title: Add pressure fluid to P4‑P5
steps.instruction: Pipet 20 µL of Pressure Fluid into each of the P4 and P5 wells.

steps.title: Clean IFC surface
steps.instruction: Blot the carrier surface with a dry, lint‑free cloth and remove any dust or debris using clear tape.

steps.title: Start Biomark HD data collection
steps.instruction: Open Biomark HD software, click “Start a New Run”, and verify that the lamp and camera status indicators are green.

steps.title: Load IFC into Biomark
steps.instruction: Place the loaded IFC into the Biomark HD instrument and click “Load”.

steps.title: Configure run parameters
steps.instruction: Provide a run name, select a file storage location, and click “Next”. Choose Application type: Gene Expression; Passive reference: ROX; Assay: Single probe; Probe type: FAM‑Non fluo (or FAM‑MGB if using a dark quencher). Click “Next”.

steps.title: Select thermal protocol
steps.instruction: Browse to and select the thermal protocol (TaqMan Covid) used for the run, confirm Auto‑Exposure is selected, then click “Next”.

steps.title: Start run
steps.instruction: Click “Start Run” to begin data acquisition.

steps.title: Store extracted RNA
steps.instruction: Store the extracted RNA samples at –20 °C (or –80 °C) for any downstream processing.

steps.title: Decontaminate tubes and exit BSL‑2
steps.instruction: Wipe tubes thoroughly with PHAGO’SPRAY ND (Phagogene) or Virospray (Sterisciences) and remove them from the BSL‑2 laboratory.
